xna-type.name: ModelProcessor
xna-type.summary: Processes a game asset mesh to a model content that is optimal for runtime.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of ModelProcessor.

property.name: ColorKeyColor
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual Color ColorKeyColor { get; set; }
property.value: Color value of the material to replace with transparent black.

property.name: ColorKeyEnabled
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual bool ColorKeyEnabled { get; set; }
property.value: true if color keying is enabled; false otherwise.

property.name: DefaultEffect
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual MaterialProcessorDefaultEffect DefaultEffect { get; set; }
property.remarks: When ModelProcessor is instantiated, DefaultEffect is set to default to BasicEffect Class .

property.name: GenerateMipmaps

property.syntax: public virtual bool GenerateMipmaps { get; set; }

property.name: GenerateTangentFrames
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual bool GenerateTangentFrames { get; set; }
property.value: true if binormals and tangents should be generated if none are found; otherwise false.

property.name: ResizeTexturesToPowerOfTwo

property.value: The amount of rotation, in degrees, around the X axis.

property.name: RotationY

property.value: The amount of rotation, in degrees, around the X axis.

property.name: RotationZ

property.name: Scale

property.name: SwapWindingOrder
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual bool SwapWindingOrder { get; set; }
property.value: true if the winding order of the model should be swapped; otherwise false. This is useful for models that appear to be drawn inside-out.

method.name: Process
method.summary: Converts mesh content to model content.

overload.summary: Converts mesh content to model content.

method.name: ProcessGeometryUsingMaterial
method.summary: Processes all geometry using a specified material.

overload.summary: Processes all geometry using a specified material.
overload.syntax: protected virtual void ProcessGeometryUsingMaterial ( MaterialContent material, IEnumerable<GeometryContent> geometryCollection, ContentProcessorContext context )

parameters.parameter: A material used in the scene.
A collection of all the geometry using the specified material.

overload.remarks: This function will be called for each material used by geometry in the input mesh, passing in a collection of all the geometry that is using the specified material. T he default implementation replaces null materials with a default BasicMaterialContent , validates that the geometry contains texture coordinates if a BasicMaterialContent has a texture, and sets the VertexColorEnabled property depending on whether the geometry contains vertex color data.

method.name: ProcessVertexChannel
method.summary: Processes geometry content vertex channels at the specified index.

overload.summary: Processes geometry content vertex channels at the specified index.
overload.syntax: protected virtual void ProcessVertexChannel ( GeometryContent geometry, int vertexChannelIndex, ContentProcessorContext context )

parameters.parameter: Index of the vertex channel to process.

overload.remarks: This function will be called for each VertexChannel of Vertices found in the input mesh. Subclasses of ModelProcessor can override ProcessVertexChannel to control how vertex data is processed. The default implementation converts VertexElementUsage.Color channels to Color format, and replaces Weights channels with a pair of VertexElementUsage.BlendIndices and VertexElementUsage.BlendIndices channels (using Byte4 format for the VertexElementUsage.BlendWeight , Color for the VertexElementUsage.BlendWeight , and discarding excess weights if there are more than four per vertex).
